vlCallContractMaxValue.title: Maximum ETH Value
vlCallContractMaxValue.description: Maximum ETH value (in wei) allowed to be sent with the transaction. Use '0' to disallow sending ETH.

vlCallContractAllowedContracts.title: Allowed Contracts
vlCallContractAllowedContracts.description: Array of allowed contract addresses. Leave empty to allow all contracts.

vlCallContractAllowedFunctions.title: Allowed Functions
vlCallContractAllowedFunctions.description: Array of allowed function names. Leave empty to allow all functions.

vlCallContractAllowedChains.title: Allowed Chains
vlCallContractAllowedChains.description: Array of allowed chain names (e.g., 'ethereum', 'polygon'). Leave empty to allow all chains.

vlCallContractAllowedCallDataPrefixes.title: Allowed Call Data Prefixes (Optional)
vlCallContractAllowedCallDataPrefixes.description: Optional array of allowed hex prefixes for appendToCallData. If defined, any appendToCallData must start with one of these prefixes.
